title: Raising a Seed Round with Against Gravity CEO Nick Fajt

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: We launch mini-series on Acquired with a subject near & dear to our heroes’ hearts: startup fundraising!
reader_summary.overview: We launch mini-series on Acquired with a subject near & dear to our heroes’ hearts: startup fundraising! This has been one of our most-requested new topics, and we’re excited to kick things off with makers of the popular Rec Room social VR app. CEO Nick Fajt joins to tell the story from company inception to building and shipping the initial product, fundraising as a first-time CEO.

key_points.text: This has been one of our most-requested new topics.
CEO Nick Fajt joins to tell the story from company inception to building and shipping the initial product, fundraising as a first-time CEO.
We had a blast touching on many classic Acquired themes for the first time “in-action” with a young, growing company.
